notes.title: Demo + Release date
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone.

We’re excited to announce our upcoming project, scheduled to release in Early Access:
Shadows of Teotihuacan — a short puzzle adventure set within the ruins of an ancient megalith.

Our primary focus has been on accuracy in recreating the Teotihuacan site. While the structures are still in a greybox phase, we’re pleased with the current level of detail and scale. Final visual polish—including terrain and foliage—will come later, once gameplay content has been fully integrated.

📅 Demo Release: June 6
📅 Early Access Launch: June 17

Thank you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542220/Shadows_of_Teotihuacan/

notes.title: Patch 1.19.5
notes.notes:
New tech

    NVIDIA DLSS technology added
    AMD FSR technology added
    makes game run faster at minimum loss of quality
    -option to activate DLSS or FSR can be located in Settings-visuals-advanced
    -graphic cards that support DLSS have DLSS option available
    -graphic cards that do NOT support DLSS have AMD FSR option available
    -turning DLSS or FSR off reverts the game back to native resolution and quality

Bug fixes

    fixed drill projectile triggering personal armor hit effect

Miscellaneous

    added smooth mouse control while in cyberspace
    minor V1.33 ghost driver UI improvements
